colorful.zh-CN: 多彩按钮，同 FloatButton；未设置时取 FloatButton 的默认值。
colorful.en-US: Colorful button, same as FloatButton. Falls back to the FloatButton default when unset.

duration.zh-CN: 滚动到顶部所需的毫秒数；点击事件按此间隔节流。
duration.en-US: Milliseconds the scroll to the top takes. The click event is throttled by this interval.

shape.zh-CN: 形状，可选 round、square；未设置时取 FloatButton 的默认值。
shape.en-US: Shape: round or square. Falls back to the FloatButton default when unset.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，可选 default、small、large；未设置时取 FloatButton 的默认值。
size.en-US: Size: default, small or large. Falls back to the FloatButton default when unset.

target.zh-CN: 返回被监听滚动的元素的函数，未设置时为 window；返回 null 表示节点尚不可用。挂载时调用，函数本身变化时重新调用；模板 ref 在父组件 mounted 之前已赋值，可直接读取。
target.en-US: Function returning the scrolled element, the window when unset. Returning null means the node is not available yet. Called on mount and again when the function itself changes. Template refs are assigned before the parent's mounted hook, so they can be read directly.

visibilityHeight.zh-CN: 出现 BackTop 需要达到的滚动高度。
visibilityHeight.en-US: Scroll distance after which the BackTop appears.

click.zh-CN: 点击时触发，载荷为原生 click 事件；按 duration 节流，发出时滚动已开始。
click.en-US: Emitted on click with the native click event. Throttled by duration, and emitted once the scroll has started.

default.zh-CN: 按钮内的静态内容，代替图标显示；不能包含可交互元素。
default.en-US: Static content of the button, shown in place of the icon. Must not contain interactive elements.

badgeCount.zh-CN: 自定义徽章内容，代替 badge.count。
badgeCount.en-US: Custom badge content, in place of badge.count.
